cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Try It First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Taste this cheap coffee substitute before I fill my cup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. If you like this, we can save the proper stuff for guests.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not sacrificing breakfast to save you money.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One sip. If it's awful, I'll buy you a croissant and keep my cup empty.

mechanism: A turns tasting a cheap substitute into a professionally controlled sample to make B test palatability before A fills a cup.
confusable: A tasting hobby shares risk; here A cup remains empty while A directs B to validate the substitute.
comparison: Tap alternative protects A physically through observer status; coffee alternative minimises B exposure with a supposedly expert sample size.
seedUse: Cheap substitute, proper coffee and croissant bargaining derive from D32-b; S03 adds tasting-size and palate rules to secure the first test.
